findings.passage: On behalf of State Freedom Caucus legislators across the country, we are urging the Congress to pass the SAVE Act (H.R. 22) immediately to ensure only U.S. citizens can vote in U.S. elections.
findings.note: Joint letter to members of Congress signed by Pace as chairman of the South Carolina caucus, with chairs from other states. Urges passage of the federal SAVE Act. Date taken from the upload path (January 2025); the letter itself carries no date.

findings.passage: If H.R. 22 is signed into law, it would update the thirty-year old National Voter Registration Act by requiring states to obtain in-person, documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering individuals to vote in federal elections.
findings.note: Same joint letter signed by Pace as chairman: describes the SAVE Act as requiring in-person documentary proof of citizenship to register for federal elections.

findings.motion: Official letter to the House Legislative Oversight Committee requesting an investigation into state agencies giving voter registration forms to non-citizens
findings.note: The House caucus post (dated by the page metadata) says Pace sent a letter to the House Legislative Oversight Committee asking it to open an investigation into allegations that a state agency gave voter registration forms to a non-citizen. Date is the post's publication date.
